changelog: Strategies are now assignable to specific challenges, so the Strategy dropdown (trade form, bulk 'Set Strategy'), the Statistics/Dashboard filter only ever offer the right ones per challenge -- a TradeFI signal-follow trade can no longer be mistagged with an FSA strategy, or the reverse.

Strategy Lab: creating or renaming a strategy shows a multi-select 'Used on these challenges', defaulting to 'All challenges' for a new strategy. Every strategy card shows its own assignment. The Lab's own list stays unfiltered by design -- it's the one place to see and change the whole picture.

Every strategy that existed before this release keeps working on every challenge, unconditionally (the new column defaults to 'all challenges'; the migration writes zero assignment rows for anything that already existed). No trade's strategy_id and no challenge's balance/drawdown figures are touched by the migration.

Trade form: the Strategy dropdown lists only strategies valid for that trade's own challenge, plus 'all challenges' ones. A trade that already has a strategy no longer valid for its challenge keeps showing it -- never silently blanked -- labelled '(not assigned to this challenge)'.

Bulk 'Set Strategy' and the Statistics/Dashboard filter now also only offer strategies valid for the active challenge. Bulk 'Set Strategy' validates this again server-side: a mismatch is rejected outright, with no partial change across the selection.

'All challenges' is stored explicitly on the strategy (applies_all_challenges), never inferred from an empty assignment set -- a strategy deliberately scoped to one challenge stays scoped, and simply stops appearing anywhere, if that challenge is later deleted. Deleting a challenge removes only its own assignment rows, never the strategy itself and never another challenge's assignments.
A challenge's own default_strategy_id (the Pre-Trade Checklist's source) is cleared to NULL, not left dangling, whenever a strategy is re-scoped away from a challenge that currently defaults to it.
release_notes: One migration: migrations/2026_10_28_0001_create_strategy_challenges.sql -- a guarded ALTER (information_schema check + PREPARE/EXECUTE, MySQL 8.4 has no ADD COLUMN IF NOT EXISTS) adding strategies.applies_all_challenges (DEFAULT 1), plus CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS strategy_challenges. Run migrate.php?mode=run after Update Now, same as any other release with a migration -- back up the live DB first. Rollback: DROP TABLE strategy_challenges; then ALTER TABLE strategies DROP COLUMN applies_all_challenges; safe in either order. Verified against the REAL migration file (not a hand-built equivalent) on a disposable local test database: run against a pre-migration shape with a pre-existing strategy and trades already carrying its strategy_id, both confirmed completely untouched afterward. 30/30 integration assertions against the real controllers over a real HTTP loopback, covering both directions of cross-challenge visibility, the bulk action's server-side rejection with zero partial change (both mismatch directions), the default_strategy_id cleanup, switching to all-challenges clearing stale rows, a new strategy defaulting to all-challenges, and a challenge delete removing only its own assignment row without touching the strategy or any other strategy's assignments. php -l and node --check pass clean on every changed file; duplicate-name scan clean; full tools/ui-harness suite (13 drivers) passes.
